text:
anna_support: FYI customer (acct: acme-corp) hit a pretty bad failure in JSON mode streaming — Go SDK panicked and the frontend shows duplicated completion requests leading to a billing spike. Request-id: req_0a1b2c3d. Logs below.

maria_engineer: Can you paste the raw stream and the SDK debug logs? Suspect schema drift: backend might be returning numeric fields as strings.

anna_support: Pasting relevant part of raw NDJSON we captured and the panic: 
```
panic: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Completion.tokens of type int

goroutine 42 [running]:
main.handleStream()
  /go/src/redwood/sdk/stream.go:87 +0x1a2
...
raw ndjson chunks:
{"type":"response","completion":{"id":"c1","tokens":"45","text":"Hello"}}
{"type":"response","completion":{"id":"c2","tokens":46,"text":" world"}}
```

simon_sdk: Confirmed — Python and TS clients coerce numeric strings for JSON mode streaming; Go uses strict typed unmarshal which throws. The subtlety: this only happens in the first chunk in some traces. When the Go decoder errors it closes the stream and the retry middleware (which only looks at transport errors) re-sends the request. The server has already consumed tokens for the original stream, so meter recorded two completions -> double billing.

kevin_sre: Repro steps that matched locally:
```bash
# run repro against staging where tokenizer path returns tokens as string in some frames
DEBUG=redwood:sdk go run ./cmd/repro -model redwood-3b --mode jsonstream --retries=2
```
Observed behavior: first run panics on chunk 1, client retries, second run succeeds, customer sees two completions in billing.

maria_engineer: I reproduced. Root cause looks like a recent change in tokenizer branch that stringified counts when a certain feature flag is enabled. Two immediate mitigations: 1) Make Go streaming decoder tolerant to number-as-string for known numeric fields (tokens, choice_index). 2) Make retry middleware treat a streaming decode error as non-retriable (since server-side work may have been consumed).

julia_billing: We already saw a charge spike tied to req_0a1b2c3d for acme-corp this morning. I've issued a temporary refund and opened BLG-321 to audit metering logic. We should also mark aborted streams differently in billing so they don't always count as full consumption.

kevin_sre: Plan of action: 
- hotfix: implement tolerant unmarshal in Go SDK (accept string->int fallback) and release patch (kevin).
- server fix: revert/patch tokenizer path to return ints (maria + infra).
- billing: add guardrail to not mark aborted streams as full consumption until server signals finalization (julia).
- longer term: add request-level idempotency/in-flight consume markers so retries don't double-charge.
ETA: hotfix + server patch by EOD, billing follow-up tomorrow.

maria_engineer: I'll open a small PR that adds a custom UnmarshalJSON for Completion.tokens that tries number then string. Also adding unit test with mixed-type NDJSON sequence.

anna_support: I contacted the customer with an explanation and refund note. Keeping them updated. CC'd BLG-321.

dev-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1133 assigned to @kevin_sre and @maria_engineer.

kevin_sre: :thumbsup: I'll also add a quick telemetry change to flag decode errors so we can catch regressions in QA.

anna_support: Closing loop here once PRs merge. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
